no_adcom_quote.quote: An advisory committee was not held for this NME as this drug is not a first in its class and outside expertise was not necessary; there were no controversial issues that would benefit from advisory committee discussion.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the alogliptin (NESINA) NDA022271 application; the Summary Review and Office/Division Director memo both state an AC was not held because the drug is not first-in-class and raised no novel or controversial regulatory/scientific issues warranting outside expertise. The Medical Review's references to Endocrinologic and Metabolic Drugs Advisory Committee meetings (July 1-2, 2008 and April 1-2, 2009) concern general class-wide FDA policy on cardiovascular safety of type 2 diabetes drugs, not a product-specific AdComm for alogliptin. Consequently there are no AdComm concern-to-change linkages for this approval.
